smoke.description: Fast health check: wallet discovery UI plus read-only API contract checks.

api.description: All API and security checks: authentication, authorization, sessions, BOLA/IDOR, injection, hostile input, data exposure, audit, concurrency, validation and business logic.

regression.description: MPC browser regression: wallet recovery, board navigation, onboarding, sessions, activities, voting and access protection.

uat.description: Automated UAT journeys from the WEB MPC local scenario suite (connect, dig, send cart, confirm, recover) against the isolated stack.

load.description: Controlled k6 concurrency and baseline checks, plus authenticated local requests adapted from the supplied JMeter recording. Mainnet and third-party traffic are refused; obsolete endpoints remain visibly blocked.

full.description: Run System Health, API (including security), Web Regression, Web UAT, Load / Performance and QA Automation sequentially.

critical-smoke.description: Critical read-only API checks and three account-access UAT journeys.

nightly-regression.description: Nightly API, web regression and full UAT; load runs weekly.

qa-automation.description: Verify QA scheduler, PR checks, reporting and dashboard behavior.

health.description: Application, database/pool, Docker services and dual-chain RPC health.
